# Mythical Encyclopedia

> > A comprehensive encyclopedia documenting mythical creatures, legendary beings, and folklore from ancient civilizations to modern cryptids across global cultures.

Mythical Encyclopedia catalogs creatures and supernatural beings from diverse mythological traditions including Chinese, Greek, Persian, Japanese, European, and Indigenous American folklore. The encyclopedia covers everything from ancient dragons and divine automatons to regional folk traditions and contemporary internet-born cryptids.

## Dragons and Serpentine Creatures

- [Western Dragon: A Friendly Overview and History of a Mythical Creature](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/western-dragon): Medieval European dragon from Mesopotamian & Indo-European mythology origins
- [Shenlong](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/shenlong): Chinese weather deity dragon from Hua Shan & Dragon Ball anime character
- [Panlong: A Mythical Creature of Chinese Folklore](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/panlong): Chinese coiling dragon from Jin Dynasty & xianxia novel by I Eat Tomatoes
- [Coi Coi-Vilu (Mythical Creature)](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/coi-coi-vilu): Mapuche water deity serpent from Chilean Chiloean Archipelago mythology
- [Zahhak](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/zahhak): Persian serpent-king tyrant from Shahnameh defeated by Fereydun

## Legendary Beasts and Hybrid Creatures

- [Wendigo: Mythical Creature Overview and History](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/wendigo): Algonquian cannibalistic winter spirit from Great Lakes & Canada folklore
- [Manticore (Mythical Creature)](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/manticore): Persian hybrid beast with human face from Greek & Roman mythology
- [Kirin: Overview and History](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/kirin): Japanese Qilin: Chinese-origin chimerical beast with cultural symbolism
- [Ziz: The Mythical Bird](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/ziz): Jewish giant sky bird from Old Testament & Babylonian Talmud folklore
- [La Velue: A Mysterious Creature of Folklore](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/la-velue): Medieval French river monster from River Huisne near La Ferté-Bernard

## Spirits, Demons, and Supernatural Entities

- [Ifrit: A Mythical Creature](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/ifrit): Powerful jinn from Islamic & Arabian mythology created by Allah
- [Talos: A Friendly Introduction](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/talos): Greek bronze automaton guardian of Crete created by Hephaestus
- [Barong: Mythical Creature Overview and History](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/barong): Balinese protective spirit opposing Rangda in Indonesian Calon Arang tale
- [Alastor: All You Need to Know](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/alastor): Greek vengeance spirit & Hazbin Hotel Radio Demon by VivziePop
- [Kui: An Introduction](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/kui): Chinese Xia dynasty creature Kuiniu & demon-queller Zhong Kui mythology

## European Folklore and Regional Traditions

- [Buckriders](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/buckriders): 18th-century Belgian & Dutch folklore: demon riders on flying goats
- [The Burry Man](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/the-burry-man): Scottish annual ritual figure from South Queensferry Ferry Fair tradition
- [Kupolė: A Friendly Introduction](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/kupole): Lithuanian summer solstice nature goddess from pagan Saint John's Day

## Optional

- [Ningen](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/ningen): Modern Japanese Antarctic humanoid cryptid from internet forums
- [Nyaid: A Festive Celebration](https://mythicalencyclopedia.com/nyaid): Greek Nereid water nymphs & NIAID infectious disease institute overview
